boundaries.guarantee: Within one hub authority domain, live task ownership and overlapping file scopes have at most one owner; federated views never merge authority.
boundaries.scope: One authoritative hub and its journal per coordination domain. Multi-hub claims remain advisory.
boundaries.title: Single authority

boundaries.guarantee: Hub-mediated mutations reject stale epochs and stale optimistic-concurrency versions.
limitations: Repository or external side effects performed outside hub mediation cannot be fenced immediately.
Universal write mediation is not implemented.
boundaries.scope: State mutations submitted through the authoritative hub protocol.
boundaries.title: Immediate-effect fencing

boundaries.guarantee: Covered coordination operations publish success only after durable commit, are apply-once for a stable operation identifier, and publish every committed live projection before post-commit cancellation propagates.
limitations: Atomic truth is not yet a universal transaction boundary for every command and external side effect.
The origin hub's outbound relay audit is not part of the owning hub's keyed transaction.
boundaries.scope: Journal-backed claim, task update, release, handoff, checkpoint, guard-denial, resource, task-board declare/update/progress, accepted recall/finding memory writes, and single-person, pending, or quorum-completing two-person governed operator-relay operation families.
boundaries.title: Atomic operation truth

boundaries.guarantee: Each observed federated (hub_id, sequence) identity is bound to one canonical full-event fingerprint; conflicting content quarantines the peer before publication.
boundaries.scope: Authorized multi-hub event observation, including persisted quarantine and explicit new-generation recovery.
boundaries.title: Content-bound global event identity

boundaries.guarantee: Federated identity equivocation fails closed; task writes can bind one observed content-bound parent, proven ancestors are removed, and divergent remaining heads produce payload-free unresolved conflict objects with deterministic non-authoritative display provenance.
limitations: Timestamp order remains display-only among unresolved causal heads and does not establish happens-before causality.
One optional parent is not a vector clock; missing edges do not prove concurrency and no automatic resolution policy is applied.
boundaries.scope: Equivocation containment plus content-bound single-parent task ancestry and unresolved-head multi-hub projections.
boundaries.title: Causal conflict handling

boundaries.guarantee: Durable journal and receipt surfaces expose bounded evidence for defined coordination and delivery outcomes without treating transport acknowledgement as model action.
limitations: Not every command or external side effect emits a universal receipt.
Evidence completeness across all adapters and deployment effects is not yet proven.
boundaries.scope: Journal-backed coordination operations, defined delivery receipts, AEF records, and federation quarantine evidence.
boundaries.title: Evidence completeness
